152193.title: The Choir of the O.L.-Vrouwekerk in Breda with the Tomb of Engelbert II of Nassau
152193.creator: Johannes Bosboom

editorial.note: The 15th-century Counts of Nassau were the direct ancestors of King William II. Their tomb in the church of Onze-Lieve-Vrouw in Breda was famous –it was even thought to have been made by Michelangelo.
A man on a ladder has placed a noose around the neck of a statue of a saint, while below three men stand ready to topple it from its socle. At the right a statue has been brutally hacked in half.
Bright light shines through the windows of this imaginary interior in a non-existent church.
